name: test_smoke_test_using_a_record_creating_fixture_is_refused_on_prod
description:
Objective: A smoke test using a record-creating fixture is refused on production.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Evaluate prod_violations for a smoke test that uses shared_application.
Expected: 1. Violation: uses shared_application.
